---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible failure
labels: bug
---

## What happened?

Describe expected and actual behavior, including the steps to reproduce.

## Environment

MineBurp version/commit, Linux distribution, launcher, Minecraft version,
server/mod loader, passive or decrypt mode.

## Evidence

Include a minimal sanitized fixture or error message and checks already tried.
Remove credentials and private captured traffic. Report security vulnerabilities
privately through https://github.com/Dospacite/MineBurp/security/advisories/new.
